about_the_game:
WAHM Demo offers a brief but intense glimpse into the psychological horror experience of the full game.
In this demo, players will explore a mysterious location haunted by eerie events and hidden threats.
Your senses will be tested as you uncover the truth, but remember — some doors are better left closed.

Features:

  • Short playable horror sequence (~10–15 minutes)

  • Light stealth and exploration mechanics

  • Cinematic atmosphere and audio design

  • Arabic and English UI support

This demo is intended to showcase the tone and mood of WAHM. The full game will offer a deeper story and expanded gameplay systems.
